verdict.rationale: Zulip's official API documents sending messages, and its bot framework covers bots that react to messages, so an agent can plausibly read and post in channels through the official API. Nothing in the pack shows scoped or permission-limited tokens. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped/least-privilege API tokens or bot permission scopes, explicit docs for the message-fetch/read endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent read and post channel messages through the official API using scoped tokens

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
Eventually, you’ll probably want to run it in a production environment where it’ll stay up, by deploying it on a server using the Zulip Botserver.
